description.zh: 模型服务的 API 密钥
description.en: The API key for the model service.
The URL of the upstream service.
The billing cost for input, measured in points per one million tokens.
The billing cost for output, measured in points per one million tokens.
The billing cost per request, measured in points.
The model service provider. The example value `bailian` is a pinyin-based identifier that corresponds to the product name Model Studio.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb create-model-service --gw-cluster-id pg-xxxxxxxxxx --name test --model-category text --protocol openai --base-url xxxx --api-key xxxx --input-cost-points-per-million 10 --output-cost-points-per-million 10 --request-cost-points 10 --vendor bailian --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb CreateModelService --region cn-hangzhou --ApiKey xxxx --RequestCostPoints 10 --GwClusterId 'pg-xxxxxxxxxx' --InputCostPointsPerMillion 10 --OutputCostPointsPerMillion 10 --BaseUrl xxxx --Vendor bailian --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ModelCategory text --Protocol openai --Name test
